title: 3 Year Postdoctoral Fellowships in Animal Behavior
level: Postdoctoral (PhD completed before the fellowship begins)
about: STRI's NOMIS–STRI three-year postdoctoral fellowships in animal behavior support projects rooted in natural history with a strong field component, on any animal taxa. Fellows must reside in Panama. Applications are due 1 April 2027.
requirements: PhD in a relevant field, completed before the fellowship begins
At least three advisors identified, at least one a STRI staff scientist
